# Admin Dashboard Project - Copilot Instructions

## Project Overview
This is an Admin Dashboard built with HTML, Tailwind CSS, and TypeScript using Vite as the build tool. The dashboard is designed to provide an intuitive interface for administrative tasks.

## Project Goals
- Create a responsive admin interface that works well on all devices
- Follow modern web development best practices
- Maintain clean, maintainable code structure
- Implement accessible UI components

## Coding Standards
- Use semantic HTML elements
- Follow TypeScript best practices for type safety
- Keep component files focused and single-purpose
- Use ES6+ JavaScript features 
- Apply consistent naming conventions

## File Organization
- HTML templates in the root directory
- TypeScript code in the `src` directory
- Assets in the `public` and `img` directories
- Styles managed primarily through Tailwind with minimal custom CSS

## Design System
- Color scheme: Use Tailwind's blue and gray color palettes as the primary colors
- Spacing: Follow Tailwind's spacing scale for consistency
- Typography: Use a clean, readable font hierarchy
- Components: Build reusable components for tables, cards, forms, and navigation

## Development Workflow
- Start with HTML structure
- Apply styling with Tailwind
- Add interactivity with TypeScript
- Test across different screen sizes

## Performance Considerations
- Minimize unnecessary re-renders
- Optimize images and assets
- Follow accessibility best practices
- Support modern browsers

## Additional Resources
- Tailwind CSS: https://tailwindcss.com/docs
- Vite: https://vitejs.dev/guide/
- TypeScript: https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/

When suggesting code, focus on clean implementation that follows these guidelines. For specific Tailwind CSS guidance, refer to the tailwind-learning.instructions.md file.
